title: Rename camera files to 'YYYY-MM-DD HHMM.ext' from the dates in their names, with a same-minute clash and a non-image left alone

turns.prompt: My phone dumped photos into {D}/camera with messy names. Rename every photo and screenshot to `YYYY-MM-DD HHMM.ext` using the date and time in its current name (keep the extension). If two would get the same name, add `-2` before the extension for the later one. Leave files that are not images alone. Tell me what you renamed.
turns.seed: mkdir -p {D}/camera && cd {D}/camera && printf 'photo-142233' > IMG_20261003_142233.jpg && printf 'photo-142259' > IMG_20261003_142259.jpg && printf 'photo-090501' > IMG_20261003_090501.jpg && printf 'photo-pxl-1812' > PXL_20260915_181200123.jpg && printf 'shot-1015' > 'Screenshot 2026-10-01 at 10.15.22.png' && printf 'buy sunscreen\n' > notes.txt && ls
turns.verify:
cd {D}/camera 2>/dev/null || { echo FAIL: camera folder gone; exit 0; }
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
want = {"2026-10-03 1422.jpg": "photo-142233", "2026-10-03 1422-2.jpg": "photo-142259", "2026-10-03 0905.jpg": "photo-090501",
        "2026-09-15 1812.jpg": "photo-pxl-1812", "2026-10-01 1015.png": "shot-1015", "notes.txt": "buy sunscreen\n"}
have = sorted(f for f in os.listdir('.') if not f.startswith('.'))
print("SHOW files=" + " | ".join(have))
bad = [f for f, c in want.items() if not os.path.isfile(f) or open(f).read() != c]
extra = [f for f in have if f not in want]
print("PASS" if not bad and not extra else f"FAIL: wrong_or_missing={bad} extra={extra}")
EOF

rubric.criteria: Pass if the five images are renamed to 2026-10-03 1422.jpg (14:22:33), 2026-10-03 1422-2.jpg (14:22:59), 2026-10-03 0905.jpg, 2026-09-15 1812.jpg and 2026-10-01 1015.png, notes.txt is untouched, nothing is lost, and the reply lists the renames including the clash. Fail if a file is overwritten or lost, the clash is resolved the wrong way round, or the reply claims renames that did not happen.

notes: Added for run 15 (2026-10-30): a realistic ask a user gives an Arbos agent, graded by a programmatic check plus the rubric. Content markers catch an overwrite in the same-minute clash.
